theorem_contract.correlation: for t>=0 the complete stationary (x,sigma) correlation matrix is R(t)=exp(A t)Sigma, with a Jordan limit at mu=2lambda; R(-t)=R(t)^T
theorem_contract.moments: all odd x moments and all E[sigma*x^(2n)] vanish; E[x^(2n)]=(v/mu)^(2n)*(1/2)_n/(alpha+1/2)_n
theorem_contract.polynomial_filter: P_N=span{x^n,sigma*x^n:0<=n<=N} is invariant with two triangular eigenvalue ladders
theorem_contract.resonance: for v>0 and 2lambda/mu=k integer, repeated eigenvalues are size-two Jordan blocks iff k is odd and are semisimple iff k is even
theorem_contract.spectrum_boundary: the claim concerns every finite polynomial filter and not the full L2 spectrum
